3	from pathlib import Path
4	from statistics import mean, median

6	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

8	numbers = []

12	        continue
13	    numbers.append(int(line) if line.lstrip("+-").isdigit() else float(line))
14	
15	stats = {
16	    "count": len(numbers),
17	    "mean": mean(numbers),
18	    "median": median(numbers),
19	}
20	
21	(HERE / "stats.txt").write_text("".join(f"{k}: {v}\n" for k, v in stats.items()))
